items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: And this guy Jackson, is he playing still? A.D. Jackson? ... Well, not him. Just another Jackson. He played. I believe he played drum.

ctx.x: With Mesro and Judy Singleton. Yeah. That's how it is.
And this guy Jackson, is he playing still? A.D. Jackson?
A.D. Jackson. A.D. Jackson. I know him. I taught him.
